A Panorama resourcepack of the space dimension added by the **[Stellaris](https://modrinth.com/project/ItTQpuBn)** mod combined with the Sky Of the **[Stellar View](https://modrinth.com/project/Iairjv0A)** mod.

#### Anyone can use or edit this resourcepack to ones liking.

The Panorama Features a Space dimension with fabulously looking sky containing a Space station
